## Generators

Draw an image from nothing.

### checkerboard-floor

**Checkerboard Floor.** Flat checkerboard plane in true perspective below a horizon, with scrolling, camera yaw and distance fog.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color1` | colour | `"#ffffff"` |  | Colour of the first set of tiles. |
| `color2` | colour | `"#000000"` |  | Colour of the second set of tiles. |
| `horizon` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0.05 – 0.95 | Height of the horizon line as a fraction of the frame, from the top. |
| `cameraHeight` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.05 – 5 | Height of the camera above the floor; higher values flatten the perspective. |
| `tileSize` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.02 – 5 | World size of one tile. |
| `scrollSpeed` | number, animatable | `0` | -5 – 5 | Forward movement speed of the camera in tiles per second (negative moves backward). |
| `rotationSpeed` | number, animatable | `0` | -3 – 3 | Camera yaw speed in radians per second. |
| `fogDistance` | number, animatable | `0.6` | 0.05 – 1 | How far the floor stays visible before fading fully into the fog colour. |
| `fogColor` | colour | `"#000000"` |  | Colour distant tiles fade into. |
| `skyColor` | colour | `"#000000"` |  | Colour filling the area above the horizon. |

### copperbars

**Copper Bars.** Amiga-style horizontal copper bars, each shaded dark to bright to dark, swinging on sine paths with near bars drawn over far ones.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `palette` | palette | `[[255,64,64],[255,170,48],[255,240,96…` |  | Bar colours, assigned to bars in order and repeating. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Swing speed of the bars. |
| `barHeight` | number, animatable | `8` | 1 – 60 | Half-height of one bar in pixels at the 640×360 reference size. |
| `smooth` | boolean | `true` |  | Smooth gradient shading; off quantizes each bar into 8 copper-style steps. |
| `count` | integer | `8` | 1 – 64 | Number of bars. |
| `alpha` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Bar brightness and opacity (fades toward the background). |
| `amplitude` | number, animatable | `0.38` | 0 – 0.5 | Vertical swing as a fraction of the frame height. |
| `spacing` | number, animatable | `0.42` | 0 – 6.28 | Phase step between consecutive bars, in radians. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour or `transparent` | `"#000000"` |  | Colour behind the bars, or transparent. |

### dot-matrix

**Dot Matrix.** A rotating 3D point cloud (sphere, torus, helix, cube or text) drawn as glowing dots, with optional morphing between two shapes.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | one of (or any string): `sphere`, `torus`, `helix`, `cube`, `text` | `"sphere"` |  | Shape the dots form; unknown names fall back to a sphere. |
| `text` | string | `"OVERSCAN"` |  | Text spelled by the dots when the shape or morph target is text. |
| `count` | integer | `2000` | 32 – 4000 | Number of dots. |
| `rotationX` | number, animatable | `0.3` | -3 – 3 | Rotation speed around the X axis in radians per second. |
| `rotationY` | number, animatable | `0.7` | -3 – 3 | Rotation speed around the Y axis in radians per second. |
| `rotationZ` | number, animatable | `0` | -3 – 3 | Rotation speed around the Z axis in radians per second. |
| `fov` | number, animatable | `300` | 40 – 1000 | Perspective scale; larger values make the object bigger on screen. |
| `pointSize` | number, animatable | `2` | 1 – 8 | Dot radius in pixels at the reference size (nearer dots are drawn larger). |
| `color` | colour or `depth` | `"depth"` |  | Single dot colour, or depth to colour dots from the palette by distance. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[32,96,255],[96,220,255],[255,255,255]]` |  | Far-to-near colour gradient used when the colour is depth. |
| `morphTarget` | one of (or any string): ``, `sphere`, `torus`, `helix`, `cube`, `text` | — |  | Second shape to morph toward; empty disables morphing. |
| `morphProgress` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | Blend from the shape (0) to the morph target (1). |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `font`.

### fire

**Fire.** Classic demoscene fire: heat is seeded along the bottom row, rises, spreads and cools, and is mapped through a palette.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cooling` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 10 | How fast heat cools as it rises; higher values give shorter flames. |
| `seed` | one of: `random`, `noise` | `"random"` |  | Bottom-row heat source: flickering random values or a smooth moving sine. |
| `seedIntensity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 2 | Strength of the heat seeded along the bottom row. |
| `seedWidth` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Width of the centred seeded region as a fraction of the frame width. |
| `spread` | integer | `3` | 1 – 9 | Number of columns averaged as heat rises, at the 640-wide reference; wider spreads blur the flames. |
| `wind` | number, animatable | `0` | -3 – 3 | Sideways drift of the flames in whole columns per step (negative leans left). |
| `palette` | palette | `[[0,0,0],[80,0,0],[200,60,0],[255,200…` |  | Colour gradient from cold to hottest. |

### fractal-zoom

**Fractal Zoom.** Mandelbrot or Julia set rendered with a cycling palette, with continuous exponential zoom.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | one of: `mandelbrot`, `julia` | `"mandelbrot"` |  | Which fractal to draw. |
| `juliaC` | vec2 | `[-0.7,0.27]` |  | Complex constant c used by the Julia set. |
| `centerX` | number, animatable | `-0.5` | -2 – 2 | Real coordinate of the view centre. |
| `centerY` | number, animatable | `0` | -2 – 2 | Imaginary coordinate of the view centre. |
| `zoom` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.0001 – 100 | Starting magnification. |
| `zoomSpeed` | number, animatable | `0` | -10 – 10 | Exponential zoom rate over time (negative zooms out). |
| `maxIter` | integer | `64` | 8 – 256 | Maximum iterations per pixel; higher values show more detail at deep zoom. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[8,6,24],[44,24,96],[110,62,170],[25…` |  | Colours mapped to escape time (the GPU path uses the first 8). |
| `paletteSpeed` | number, animatable | `0` | -5 – 5 | Speed at which colours cycle through the palette. |
| `smooth` | boolean | `true` |  | Smooth colour banding between iterations (CPU renderer only). |

### game-of-life

**Game of Life.** Conway's Game of Life on a cell grid, coloured as plain on/off, by cell age, or through an age palette.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `randomSeed` | integer | `1` | 0 – 9999 | Seed for the random starting pattern; vary it to decorrelate identical nodes. |
| `seed` | one of (or any string): `random`, `glider`, `rPentomino` | `"random"` |  | Starting pattern: random fill, a single glider, or an R-pentomino. |
| `seedDensity` | number | `0.3` | 0.01 – 1 | Fraction of cells alive at the start of a random seed. |
| `aliveColor` | colour | `"#ffffff"` |  | Colour of live cells (the mature colour in age mode). |
| `deadColor` | colour | `"#000000"` |  | Colour of dead cells (the newborn colour in age mode). |
| `scale` | integer | `6` | 1 – 16 | Cell size in pixels at the 640×360 reference size. |
| `speed` | integer | `1` | 1 – 8 | Generations computed per simulation step. |
| `wrap` | boolean | `true` |  | Wrap the grid edges so patterns leaving one side re-enter the other. |
| `colorMode` | one of: `binary`, `age`, `palette` | `"binary"` |  | Colour live cells with one colour, fade dead-to-alive by age, or sample the age palette. |
| `agePalette` | palette | `[[26,34,46],[74,222,128],[255,255,255]]` |  | Colours from newborn to old cells in palette mode. |

### glenz

**Glenz Vectors.** Translucent faceted glenz object (a cube with a pyramid on each face) whose back faces show through the front ones.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `palette` | palette | `[[255,255,255],[72,154,255],[255,84,1…` |  | Front faces alternate the first two colours; back faces use the third and fourth. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour | `"#04060e"` |  | Colour behind the object. |
| `alpha` | number, animatable | `0.45` | 0.05 – 1 | Opacity of the front faces. |
| `scale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 3 | Size of the object. |
| `rotationX` | number, animatable | `0.55` | -3 – 3 | Rotation speed around the X axis in radians per second. |
| `rotationY` | number, animatable | `0.95` | -3 – 3 | Rotation speed around the Y axis in radians per second. |
| `rotationZ` | number, animatable | `0.35` | -3 – 3 | Rotation speed around the Z axis in radians per second. |
| `fov` | number, animatable | `220` | 40 – 800 | Perspective scale; larger values make the object bigger on screen. |
| `cameraZ` | number, animatable | `4.4` | 2.5 – 12 | Camera distance from the object; closer gives stronger perspective. |
| `spike` | number | `1.45` | 1 – 3 | How far each face pyramid sticks out (1 is a flat cube). |

### lasers

**Lasers.** Club-style laser show: fans of glowing beams sweep and rotate from emitters along the bottom, pulsing with the audio.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beamCount` | integer | `18` | 1 – 64 | Beams per emitter (the GPU path draws at most 32). |
| `emitterCount` | integer | `3` | 1 – 6 | Number of laser emitters. |
| `spread` | number, animatable | `1.6` | 0.08 – 3.14 | Angular width of each beam fan in radians. |
| `sweepSpeed` | number, animatable | `0.9` | 0 – 5 | Speed of the wave that sweeps beams back and forth within each fan. |
| `rotationSpeed` | number, animatable | `0.45` | 0 – 3 | Speed at which each whole fan swings from side to side. |
| `beamWidth` | number, animatable | `2.2` | 0.5 – 10 | Width of the bright beam core in pixels at the reference size. |
| `glowWidth` | number, animatable | `18` | 0.5 – 60 | Width of the soft glow around each beam in pixels at the reference size (never narrower than the core). |
| `length` | number, animatable | `1.15` | 0.1 – 2 | Beam length relative to the smaller frame dimension. |
| `intensity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 3 | Overall beam brightness. |
| `jitter` | number, animatable | `0.08` | 0 – 1 | Amplitude of the fast shimmer in the beam angles, in radians. |
| `drift` | number, animatable | `0.2` | 0 – 2 | How far the emitters slowly wander around their base positions. |
| `audioReactive` | number, animatable | `0.4` | 0 – 2 | How strongly audio loudness and spectral energy boost the beam intensity. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour | `"#020409"` |  | Colour behind the beams. |
| `palette` | json | `["#ff2bd6","#45f4ff","#7dff6b","#ffd8…` |  | List of hex beam colours, cycled across beams and emitters (the GPU path uses the first 4). |

### lissajous

**Lissajous.** An oscilloscope-style Lissajous curve traced as a glowing line with a fading phosphor trail.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | number, animatable | `3` | 0 – 12 | Horizontal frequency of the curve. |
| `b` | number, animatable | `2` | 0 – 12 | Vertical frequency of the curve. |
| `delta` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 6.28 | Phase offset of the horizontal wave in radians. |
| `amplitude` | number, animatable | `0.8` | 0 – 1 | Size of the curve as a fraction of half the frame. |
| `trailLength` | integer | `512` | 32 – 4096 | Number of segments drawn along the curve each frame. |
| `decay` | number, animatable | `0.95` | 0 – 1 | Per-frame persistence of the trail; lower values fade faster. |
| `color` | colour | `"#00ff88"` |  | Line colour. |
| `lineWidth` | number, animatable | `1` | 1 – 8 | Line thickness in pixels at the reference size. |
| `glow` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | Amount of soft glow around the line. |

### matrix-rain

**Matrix Rain.** Falling columns of glyphs with bright heads and fading trails, in the style of The Matrix.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `randomSeed` | integer | `1` | 0 – 9999 | Seed for column placement and glyph choice; vary it to decorrelate identical nodes. |
| `charset` | one of (or any string): `katakana`, `ascii`, `binary`, `hex` | `"katakana"` |  | Preset character set, or a literal string of characters to use. |
| `color` | colour | `"#00ff41"` |  | Colour of the trailing glyphs. |
| `headColor` | colour | `"#ffffff"` |  | Colour of the leading glyph in each column. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.05 – 5 | Falling speed of the columns. |
| `density` | number, animatable | `0.7` | 0 – 1 | Fraction of columns that carry rain. |
| `trailLength` | number, animatable | `0.3` | 0.05 – 1 | Trail length as a fraction of the frame height. |
| `fontSize` | integer | `16` | 6 – 32 | Glyph cell height in pixels. |
| `glitch` | number, animatable | `0.02` | 0 – 1 | Chance that a glyph briefly flickers to a different character. |

### metaballs

**Metaballs.** Blobby metaballs moving on sine paths that merge where their fields overlap, coloured through a palette.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer | `5` | 1 – 12 | Number of balls. |
| `threshold` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0.05 – 2 | Field level at the blob edge; lower values make bigger, more merged blobs. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Movement speed of the balls. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[8,4,24],[76,14,112],[255,50,170],[2…` |  | Colour gradient from the blob edge to its core (the GPU path uses the first 8). |
| `freqX` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Horizontal oscillation frequency of the ball paths. |
| `freqY` | number, animatable | `0.7` | 0 – 5 | Vertical oscillation frequency of the ball paths. |
| `glow` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | Widens the soft falloff around the blobs. |

### moire

**Moiré.** Two overlapping line, ring or radial patterns whose interference makes shifting moiré fringes.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of: `grid`, `rings`, `radial` | `"grid"` |  | Shape of the two interfering patterns. |
| `freq1` | number, animatable | `20` | 1 – 100 | Frequency of the first pattern. |
| `freq2` | number, animatable | `21` | 1 – 100 | Frequency of the second pattern; small differences from freq1 give wide fringes. |
| `angle1` | number, animatable | `0` | -3.14 – 3.14 | Rotation of the first pattern in radians. |
| `angle2` | number, animatable | `0.05` | -3.14 – 3.14 | Rotation of the second pattern in radians. |
| `speed1` | number, animatable | `0` | -10 – 10 | Phase drift speed of the first pattern. |
| `speed2` | number, animatable | `0` | -10 – 10 | Phase drift speed of the second pattern. |
| `contrast` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 5 | Gain applied to the interference before it is mapped to the palette. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[0,0,0],[255,255,255]]` |  | Colours the interference value is mapped through (up to 8 on the GPU). |

### oscilloscope

**Oscilloscope.** A glowing oscilloscope trace of a synthetic waveform over a graticule, with optional phosphor persistence.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | colour | `"#00ff88"` |  | Colour of the trace. |
| `lineWidth` | number, animatable | `2` | 1 – 10 | Trace thickness in pixels at the 640×360 reference. |
| `triggerMode` | one of: `free`, `rising`, `falling` | `"rising"` |  | Edge the trace syncs to so the waveform holds still; free runs unsynced. |
| `triggerLevel` | number, animatable | `0` | -1 – 1 | Signal level that fires the trigger. |
| `timeScale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 5 | Horizontal time span shown across the screen. |
| `voltScale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 5 | Vertical gain of the waveform. |
| `persistence` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | How much of the previous frame is kept, giving the trace a fading afterglow. |
| `gridColor` | colour | `"#1a1a1a"` |  | Colour of the graticule lines. |
| `gridDivisions` | integer | `8` | 2 – 16 | Number of graticule divisions on each axis. |
| `phosphorColor` | colour or  | — |  | Colour of a soft halo drawn around the trace; empty for no halo. |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `source`.

### plasma

**Plasma.** Classic sum-of-sines plasma mapped through a cycling colour palette.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Animation speed multiplier. |
| `scale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 5 | Size of the plasma pattern; larger values zoom out. |
| `complexity` | integer | `4` | 2 – 8 | Number of sine terms summed (more = busier pattern). |
| `palette` | palette | `[[255,0,128],[255,128,0],[128,255,0],…` |  | Colours the plasma cycles through. |

### raymarcher

**Raymarcher.** Sphere-traces a signed-distance scene written in GLSL, lit by a single directional light with distance fog.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | string | `"return sdSphere(p, 0.85);"` |  | Body of the scene distance function in GLSL, given the point p. |
| `scenePath` | text file | — |  | File holding the scene code; overrides scene once loaded. |
| `maxSteps` | integer | `64` | 8 – 128 | Maximum marching steps per ray. |
| `maxDist` | number | `100` | 4 – 500 | Distance after which a ray counts as a miss. |
| `epsilon` | number | `0.001` | 0.0001 – 0.05 | Surface hit threshold; larger is faster but blurrier. |
| `cameraPos` | json | `[0,0,3]` |  | Camera position as [x, y, z]; each component may be a number or an animatable reference. |
| `camera` | json | `{"pos":[0,0,3],"target":[0,0,0]}` |  | Camera as { pos, target }; target sets the look-at point and pos is used when cameraPos is absent. |
| `lightDir` | vec3 | `[1,1,-1]` |  | Direction of the light (normalised automatically). |
| `fogColor` | colour | `"#000000"` |  | Colour rays fade to with distance and on a miss. |
| `chunkyScale` | integer | `4` | 1 – 8 | Pixel block size for the CPU fallback renderer. |
| `disableGpu` | boolean | `false` |  | Forces the CPU renderer even when WebGL is available. |

### rotozoom

**Rotozoom.** A tiled texture rotated and zoomed around a centre point, the classic rotozoomer.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textureUrl` | image file | — |  | Image to tile; without one a built-in checker pattern is used. |
| `rotationSpeed` | number, animatable | `1` | -5 – 5 | Rotation speed in radians per second. |
| `zoomSpeed` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 5 | Speed of the zoom oscillation. |
| `zoomRange` | vec2 | `[0.5,2]` |  | Minimum and maximum zoom the oscillation swings between. |
| `centerX` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Horizontal rotation centre as a fraction of the width. |
| `centerY` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Vertical rotation centre as a fraction of the height. |
| `tileX` | integer | `2` | 1 – 16 | Texture repeats across the pattern horizontally. |
| `tileY` | integer | `2` | 1 – 16 | Texture repeats across the pattern vertically. |

### scroller

**Scroller.** A bitmap-font text line scrolling across the screen on a sine wave, in per-column or per-character (DYCP) style.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | `" PHASE TWO · DEMOSCENE TOOLKIT "` |  | Text to scroll. |
| `font` | one of (or any string): `overscan://fonts/ShareTechMono`, `overscan://fonts/Tiny5x7`, `overscan://fonts/Press2P` | `"overscan://fonts/ShareTechMono"` |  | Built-in bitmap font; unknown names fall back to ShareTechMono. |
| `fontSize` | number | `28` | 8 – 128 | Text height in pixels at the 640×360 reference, snapped to whole glyph scales. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `40` | -200 – 200 | Scroll speed; values within ±1.5 are treated as a relative multiplier. |
| `initialScroll` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 2000 | Scroll offset in pixels at time zero. |
| `waveAmplitude` | number, animatable | `4` | 0 – 60 | Height of the sine wave in pixels at the 640×360 reference. |
| `waveFrequency` | number, animatable | `0.08` | 0 – 2 | Wave frequency in radians per character. |
| `waveSpeed` | number, animatable | `3` | -20 – 20 | Speed the wave moves at. |
| `color` | colour | `"#ffe8b0"` |  | Text colour. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour or `transparent` | `"transparent"` |  | Fill behind the text, or transparent. |
| `asciiFont` | boolean | `false` |  | Renders hard black-and-white pixels with an opaque black background. |
| `verticalPosition` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Vertical position of the line, from top (0) to bottom (1). |
| `letterSpacing` | number, animatable | `0` | -10 – 40 | Extra pixels between characters. |
| `mode` | one of: `sine`, `dycp` | `"sine"` |  | Sine bends each pixel column; dycp moves each character as a block. |

### shadebobs

**Shadebobs.** Flat bobs stamped along Lissajous paths that add to a wrapping colour index, building contour bands.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer | `10` | 1 – 48 | Number of bobs. |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `22` | 2 – 100 | Bob radius in pixels at the 640×360 reference. |
| `freqX` | number, animatable | `1.2` | 0 – 10 | Horizontal frequency of the bob paths. |
| `freqY` | number, animatable | `1.8` | 0 – 10 | Vertical frequency of the bob paths. |
| `amplitude` | number, animatable | `0.34` | 0 – 0.48 | Path extent as a fraction of the frame. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Multiplier on how fast the bobs travel. |
| `decay` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Per-tick retention of the accumulated field; 1 never fades. |
| `intensity` | number, animatable | `0.22` | 0.05 – 2 | Colour-index step added per stamp. |
| `phaseSpread` | number | `0.8` | 0 – 3.14 | Phase offset between successive bobs along the path. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour | `"#05060d"` |  | Colour at index 0, where no bob has passed yet. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[22,10,36],[90,28,128],[255,76,168],…` |  | Looping colours the accumulated index cycles through. |

### sinebobs

**Sinebobs.** Glowing sprites following a chain of Lissajous paths, with optional motion trails.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer | `16` | 1 – 64 | Number of bobs. |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `20` | 2 – 100 | Bob radius in pixels at the 640×360 reference. |
| `freqX` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 10 | Horizontal frequency of the bob paths. |
| `freqY` | number, animatable | `1.3` | 0 – 10 | Vertical frequency of the bob paths. |
| `amplitude` | number, animatable | `0.4` | 0 – 0.48 | Path extent as a fraction of the frame. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[255,96,64],[255,220,96],[96,255,160…` |  | Colours spread across the bobs from first to last. |
| `sprite` | one of (or any string): `circle`, `star`, `diamond` | `"circle"` |  | Shape of each bob; unknown names draw a circle. |
| `trail` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | How much of the previous frame is kept, leaving trails behind the bobs. |
| `phaseSpread` | number | `1` | 0 – 3.14 | Phase offset between successive bobs along the path. |

### starfield

**Starfield.** Stars flying out from a vanishing point, growing as they approach.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `randomSeed` | integer | `1` | 0 – 99999 | Seed for the star layout; vary it to decorrelate identical nodes. |
| `count` | integer | `120` | 1 – 2000 | Number of stars. |
| `warpSpeed` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.05 – 10 | Speed the stars fly toward the viewer. |
| `starColor` | vec3 | `[255,255,255]` |  | Star colour as [r, g, b] (0–255). |
| `spread` | number | `1` | 0.1 – 5 | How far from the centre stars are scattered. |
| `sizeRange` | vec2 | `[1,3]` |  | Star size in pixels when far and when near. |
| `centerX` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Horizontal vanishing point as a fraction of the width. |
| `centerY` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Vertical vanishing point as a fraction of the height. |

### text

**Text.** Static bitmap-font text, single or multi-line, placed anywhere on screen.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | `"OVERSCAN"` |  | Text to draw; newlines start new lines. |
| `font` | one of (or any string): `overscan://fonts/ShareTechMono`, `overscan://fonts/Tiny5x7`, `overscan://fonts/Press2P` | `"overscan://fonts/ShareTechMono"` |  | Built-in bitmap font; unknown names fall back to ShareTechMono. |
| `fontSize` | number | `24` | 8 – 128 | Text height in pixels at the 640×360 reference, snapped to whole glyph scales. |
| `color` | colour | `"#ffffff"` |  | Text colour. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour or `transparent` | `"transparent"` |  | Fill behind the text, or transparent. |
| `align` | one of: `left`, `center`, `right` | `"center"` |  | Horizontal alignment of the text relative to the anchor point. |
| `letterSpacing` | number, animatable | `0` | -10 – 40 | Extra pixels between characters. |
| `lineHeight` | number, animatable | `1.15` | 1 – 3 | Line spacing as a multiple of the glyph height. |
| `x` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Horizontal anchor as a fraction of the width. |
| `y` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Vertical centre of the text block as a fraction of the height. |

### tunnel

**Tunnel.** A textured tunnel flown through by mapping screen angle and depth onto a texture.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textureUrl` | image file | — |  | Image wrapped around the tunnel wall; without one a built-in pattern is used. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | -5 – 5 | Speed of travel down the tunnel. |
| `twist` | number, animatable | `0` | -2 – 2 | Rotation of the texture with depth, giving a corkscrew. |
| `fog` | number, animatable | `0.4` | 0 – 1 | How quickly the far end fades to black. |
| `zoom` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.05 – 5 | Tunnel radius scale. |
| `offsetX` | number, animatable | `0` | -1 – 1 | Horizontal offset of the vanishing point. |
| `offsetY` | number, animatable | `0` | -1 – 1 | Vertical offset of the vanishing point. |

### twister

**Twister.** Classic twister bar: a square column whose rotation varies down the screen, with shaded faces.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `palette` | palette | `[[255,72,154],[255,203,76],[92,246,16…` |  | Colours of the four faces (extra entries are ignored). |
| `backgroundColor` | colour | `"#050812"` |  | Colour behind the twister. |
| `twistSpeed` | number, animatable | `1.6` | -10 – 10 | Rotation speed of the column. |
| `verticalFrequency` | number, animatable | `1.35` | 0.05 – 10 | How much the twist angle changes down the screen. |
| `width` | number, animatable | `0.24` | 0.04 – 0.45 | Column width as a fraction of the frame width. |
| `sway` | number, animatable | `0.16` | 0 – 0.35 | How far the column sways side to side. |
| `centerX` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0.1 – 0.9 | Horizontal centre of the column as a fraction of the width. |
| `shading` | number, animatable | `0.7` | 0 – 1 | Strength of the face shading by angle. |

### vector-balls

**Vector Balls.** Shaded balls on the vertices and edges of a rotating 3D object that morphs between shapes.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer | `20` | 1 – 96 | Number of balls. |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `18` | 2 – 80 | Ball radius in pixels at the 640×360 reference, at the object centre depth. |
| `freqX` | number, animatable | `2` | -10 – 10 | Rotation speed around the X axis. |
| `freqY` | number, animatable | `3` | -10 – 10 | Rotation speed around the Y axis. |
| `freqZ` | number, animatable | `1` | -10 – 10 | Rotation speed around the Z axis. |
| `amplitude` | number, animatable | `0.3` | 0 – 1 | Object size as a fraction of the frame short side. |
| `shapes` | json | `["cube","sphere","ring"]` |  | Shapes the balls morph through in order, looping (cube, octahedron, sphere, ring, helix). |
| `morphPeriod` | number | `4` | 0.5 – 30 | Seconds spent on each shape, including the morph into the next. |
| `lightDir` | vec3 | `[-1,-1,-1]` |  | Direction toward the light in screen axes (x right, y down, z into the screen). |
| `palette` | palette | `[[150,158,176],[176,186,202],[206,214…` |  | Ball colours. |
| `specular` | number, animatable | `0.8` | 0 – 2 | Strength of the specular highlight. |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `phaseSpread`.

### voxel-landscape

**Voxel Landscape.** Comanche-style voxel terrain flown over, from a heightmap image or procedural noise.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heightmap` | one of (or any string): `noise` | `"noise"` |  | Heightmap image path, or noise for procedural terrain. |
| `colormap` | one of (or any string): `auto` | `"auto"` |  | Colour map image path, or auto to colour by height. |
| `horizon` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Horizon line as a fraction of the height. |
| `scale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 5 | Vertical scale of the terrain. |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | -5 – 5 | Forward flying speed. |
| `cameraHeight` | number, animatable | `150` | 0 – 500 | Camera altitude above the terrain base. |
| `cameraAngle` | number, animatable | `0` | -3.14 – 3.14 | Heading of the camera in radians. |
| `drawDistance` | integer | `300` | 40 – 600 | How far the terrain is drawn before the fog. |
| `fogColor` | colour | `"#87ceeb"` |  | Sky and distance fog colour. |

### water-ripple

**Water Ripple.** A height-field water simulation whose ripples refract a texture or pool-tile pattern.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textureUrl` | image file | — |  | Image refracted by the waves; without one a pool-tile pattern built from the palette is used. |
| `randomSeed` | integer | `1` | 0 – 99999 | Seed for tap positions; vary it to decorrelate identical nodes. |
| `damping` | number, animatable | `0.99` | 0.85 – 0.999 | How long ripples last; higher values fade more slowly. |
| `tapMode` | one of: `random`, `beat`, `cursor`, `none` | `"random"` |  | What drops new ripples: random taps, the beat, or nothing (cursor currently adds none). |
| `tapRate` | number, animatable | `2` | 0 – 20 | Random taps per second. |
| `tapStrength` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Strength of each tap. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[6,18,40],[24,88,160],[96,196,255],[…` |  | Colours of the fallback pool-tile pattern. |
| `refraction` | number, animatable | `0.3` | 0 – 1 | How strongly the waves bend the underlying image. |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `backgroundUrl`.

### wireframe

**Wireframe.** A rotating wireframe cube drawn with perspective lines.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | colour | `"#88f8ff"` |  | Line colour. |
| `backgroundColor` | colour | `"#04070f"` |  | Colour behind the cube. |
| `lineWidth` | number, animatable | `2` | 1 – 10 | Line thickness in pixels at the 640×360 reference. |
| `scale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.1 – 3 | Size of the cube. |
| `rotationX` | number, animatable | `0.7` | -5 – 5 | Rotation speed around the X axis. |
| `rotationY` | number, animatable | `1.1` | -5 – 5 | Rotation speed around the Y axis. |
| `rotationZ` | number, animatable | `0.4` | -5 – 5 | Rotation speed around the Z axis. |
| `fov` | number, animatable | `230` | 40 – 600 | Perspective focal length in pixels; larger values magnify the cube. |
| `cameraZ` | number, animatable | `4.5` | 2.5 – 20 | Camera distance from the cube. |

## Modifiers

Take one image (input `in`) and transform it.

### ansi-art

**ANSI Art.** Redraws the input as a grid of text-mode cells (blocks, ASCII glyphs or braille dots) coloured by the average of each cell.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `charset` | one of: `block`, `ascii`, `braille`, `custom` | `"block"` |  | Cell style: partial blocks, ASCII ramp, braille dots, or the characters in customChars. |
| `customChars` | string | — |  | Characters from darkest to brightest, used when charset is custom (empty falls back to the ASCII ramp). |
| `colorMode` | one of: `24bit`, `256`, `mono` | `"24bit"` |  | Cell colour depth: full colour, the ANSI 256-colour cube, or greyscale. |
| `dither` | boolean | `false` |  | Applies Floyd–Steinberg error diffusion to the cell brightness levels. |

### blur

**Blur.** Box blur of the input; a preset of Blur / Glow in blur mode.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `2` | 0 – 8 | Blur radius in pixels, rounded and capped at 8. |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `passes`, `quality`.

### blur-glow

**Blur / Glow.** Box blur that either replaces the input (blur) or is added back on top of it (glow).

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `2` | 0 – 8 | Blur radius in pixels, rounded and capped at 8. |
| `mode` | one of: `blur`, `glow` | `"blur"` |  | Blur replaces the image; glow adds the blurred image on top of the original. |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | How much of the blurred image is added in glow mode. |
| `glowStrength` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Alias for strength, used only when strength is not set. |

### chromatic-aberration

**Chromatic Aberration.** Shifts the red and blue channels in opposite directions to fake lens colour fringing.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | number, animatable | `3` | 0 – 20 | Channel offset in pixels. |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `3` | 0 – 20 | Alias for amount; takes precedence when set. |
| `angle` | number, animatable | `0` | -3.1416 – 3.1416 | Direction of the channel shift in radians. |
| `radial` | boolean | `false` |  | Scales the shift with distance from the centre, leaving the middle clean. |

### color-grade

**Color Grade.** Remaps the input through a luminance gradient palette or per-channel curves, blended with the original.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of: `1d`, `3d`, `curves` | `"1d"` |  | Grading method: luminance-to-palette gradient (3d currently behaves like 1d) or per-channel curves. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[18,14,40],[80,54,128],[255,126,96],…` |  | Gradient from shadows to highlights (up to 8 colours) used by the 1d mode. |
| `curves` | json | — |  | Per-channel lookup curves { r, g, b } of output values 0–255, used by the curves mode. |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Mix between the original (0) and the fully graded image (1). |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `lutUrl`.

### crt

**CRT.** Cathode-ray tube look: scanlines, barrel distortion, vignette, phosphor glow and an optional RGB shadow mask.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanlineStrength` | number, animatable | `0.35` | 0 – 1 | How much every other line is darkened. |
| `barrelDistortion` | number, animatable | `0.1` | -0.5 – 0.5 | Barrel warp of the picture; added to curvature. |
| `vignetteStrength` | number, animatable | `0.15` | 0 – 1 | How much the corners are darkened. |
| `vignetteRadius` | number, animatable | `0.7` | 0.1 – 2 | Size of the unvignetted centre; larger values push the darkening outward. |
| `phosphorGlow` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | Extra brightness bleed added back from the source pixel. |
| `rgbMask` | boolean | `false` |  | Overlays a vertical red/green/blue aperture-grille mask. |
| `curvature` | number, animatable | `0.1` | -0.5 – 0.5 | Screen curvature; combined with barrelDistortion to warp the image. |
| `brightness` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 2 | Overall brightness multiplier. |

### emboss

**Emboss.** Relief shading from the brightness difference along a light direction, in grey or tinted by the original colour.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle` | number, animatable | `45` | 0 – 360 | Light direction in degrees (snaps to the nearest 45° neighbour). |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 5 | Depth of the relief. |
| `color` | boolean | `false` |  | Keeps the original hue instead of producing a grey relief. |

### feedback

**Feedback.** Blends each frame with a shifted, scaled copy of the previous output to leave trails and tunnels.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `decay` | number, animatable | `0.85` | 0 – 1 | How much of the previous frame is kept (0 = none, 1 = full trail), normalised to 30 fps. |
| `blendMode` | one of: `alpha`, `additive` | `"alpha"` |  | Alpha cross-fades with the previous frame; additive adds it on top. |
| `offsetX` | number, animatable | `0` | -0.05 – 0.05 | Horizontal drift of the previous frame per step, as a fraction of the width. |
| `offsetY` | number, animatable | `0` | -0.05 – 0.05 | Vertical drift of the previous frame per step, as a fraction of the height. |
| `scale` | number, animatable | `1` | 0.9 – 1.1 | Zoom of the previous frame per step; above 1 zooms in, below 1 zooms out. |

### glow

**Glow.** Adds a blurred copy of the input on top of itself; a preset of Blur / Glow in glow mode.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `2` | 0 – 8 | Blur radius of the glow in pixels, rounded and capped at 8. |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | How much of the blurred image is added on top. |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `threshold`, `color`, `passes`.

### lens

**Lens.** Magnifying-glass bulge inside a circular area, with optional colour fringing.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `0.22` | 0 – 2 | How strongly the zoom is applied inside the lens. |
| `radius` | number, animatable | `0.32` | 0.05 – 1 | Lens radius as a fraction of the frame. |
| `zoom` | number, animatable | `1.2` | 0.2 – 4 | Magnification at the lens centre; below 1 shrinks instead. |
| `centerX` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Horizontal lens position (0 = left, 1 = right). |
| `centerY` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Vertical lens position (0 = top, 1 = bottom). |
| `chroma` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 4 | Radial colour fringing inside the lens. |

### mirror

**Mirror.** Reflects the image around an origin point, horizontally, vertically, into four quadrants or eight kaleidoscope slices.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of: `horizontal`, `vertical`, `quad`, `octal` | `"quad"` |  | Symmetry: one axis, the other axis, both axes, or both axes plus the diagonal. |
| `originX` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Horizontal position of the mirror axis (0 = left, 1 = right). |
| `originY` | number, animatable | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Vertical position of the mirror axis (0 = top, 1 = bottom). |

### palette-cycle

**Palette Cycle.** Maps pixel brightness through a palette whose offset rotates over time, like classic colour cycling.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | number, animatable | `1` | -5 – 5 | Cycling speed; negative values run backwards. |
| `palette` | palette | `[[0,0,0],[255,0,128],[255,200,40],[25…` |  | Colours cycled through (up to 8 on the GPU path). |
| `range` | vec2 | `[0,1]` |  | Brightness range [low, high] (0–1) that is recoloured; pixels outside it are left untouched. |
| `pingPong` | boolean | `false` |  | Swings the cycle back and forth instead of looping in one direction. |

### palette-flash

**Palette Flash.** Flashes the image towards a solid colour, typically driven by a beat or track.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | colour | `"#ffffff"` |  | Flash colour. |
| `strength` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | Flash amount; 0 leaves the image untouched. |
| `blendMode` | one of: `alpha`, `additive` | `"alpha"` |  | Alpha mixes towards the colour; additive adds the colour on top. |

### pixelate

**Pixelate.** Reduces the image to large blocks, drawn as squares, circles or diamonds.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | number, animatable | `8` | 1 – 64 | Block size in pixels, rounded to a whole number. |
| `blockSize` | number, animatable | `8` | 1 – 64 | Alias for size; takes precedence when set. |
| `shape` | one of: `square`, `circle`, `diamond` | `"square"` |  | Shape of each block; outside the shape the original pixels show through. |

## Compositors

Combine several images.

### additive-blend

**Additive Blend.** Adds the overlay onto the base, optionally masked by the luminance of a mask input.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 2 | Multiplier on the added overlay; values above 1 over-brighten. |
| `clamp` | boolean | `true` |  | Clamps the summed colour to white instead of letting it overflow. |

### alpha-blend

**Alpha Blend.** Standard "over" compositing of the overlay onto the base using its alpha, optionally masked.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Overlay opacity. |
| `premultiplied` | boolean | `false` |  | Treats the overlay colour as already multiplied by its alpha. |

### difference-blend

**Difference Blend.** Absolute difference of base and overlay, optionally masked.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Mix between the base (0) and the full difference (1). |
| `invert` | boolean | `false` |  | Inverts the resulting colour. |

### multiply-blend

**Multiply Blend.** Multiplies base by overlay, darkening it, optionally masked.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Mix between the base (0) and the full multiply (1). |

### overlay-blend

**Overlay Blend.** Overlay blend: multiplies the base darks and screens its lights with the overlay, optionally masked.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Mix between the base (0) and the full overlay blend (1). |

### screen-blend

**Screen Blend.** Screen blend that brightens the base with the overlay, optionally masked.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 1 | Mix between the base (0) and the full screen blend (1). |

### transition

**Transition.** Transitions from base to overlay with a dissolve, wipe, zoom, iris or flash, driven by a progress value.

Inputs: `base`, `overlay`, `mask`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of: `dissolve`, `wipe-left`, `wipe-right`, `wipe-up`, `wipe-down`, `zoom-out`, `flash`, `iris` | `"dissolve"` |  | Transition style. |
| `progress` | number, animatable | `0` | 0 – 1 | Transition position from base (0) to overlay (1), usually driven by a track. |
| `easing` | one of: `step`, `linear`, `smooth`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out`, `elastic`, `bounce`, `back`, `expo-in`, `expo-out` | `"smooth"` |  | Easing curve applied to progress. |
| `flashColor` | colour | `"#ffffff"` |  | Colour flashed mid-transition in flash mode. |

## Signals

Produce numbers that other nodes can use as `{ "node": id, "output": name }`.

### audio-analyser

**Audio Analyser.** Analyses a WAV file in sync with the timeline and outputs loudness, brightness, beat, zero-crossing, chroma and MFCC-style bands.

Outputs: `rms`, `spectral`, `beat`, `zcr`, `chroma-0`, `chroma-1`, `chroma-2`, `chroma-3`, `chroma-4`, `chroma-5`, `chroma-6`, `chroma-7`, `chroma-8`, `chroma-9`, `chroma-10`, `chroma-11`, `mfcc-0`, `mfcc-1`, `mfcc-2`, `mfcc-3`, `mfcc-4`, `mfcc-5`, `mfcc-6`, `mfcc-7`, `mfcc-8`, `mfcc-9`, `mfcc-10`, `mfcc-11`, `mfcc-12`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | audio file | — |  | 16-bit PCM WAV file (mono or stereo) to analyse. |
| `bufferSize` | integer | `512` | 128 – 2048 | Analysis window length in samples. |
| `bpmEstimate` | number | `120` | 40 – 240 | Tempo of the synthetic beat output used when no audio is loaded. |

Ignored (kept for compatibility): `features`.

### lfo

**LFO.** Low-frequency oscillator producing a periodic wave (or stepped random values) plus its phase.

Outputs: `value`, `phase`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | one of: `sine`, `triangle`, `square`, `sawtooth`, `ramp`, `random` | `"sine"` |  | Waveform; random holds a new value each cycle. |
| `rate` | json | `1` |  | Speed in Hz (a number or track reference), or { bars: n } for one cycle every n bars at the current BPM. |
| `phase` | number | `0` | 0 – 1 | Starting phase offset in cycles. |
| `bipolar` | boolean | `true` |  | Outputs -1…1 when on, 0…1 when off (before amplitude and offset). |
| `amplitude` | number, animatable | `1` | 0 – 10 | Multiplier applied to the wave. |
| `offset` | number, animatable | `0` | -10 – 10 | Value added after the amplitude. |
| `smooth` | number | `0` | 0 – 1 | Per-tick smoothing of the output (0 = none, near 1 = very slow). |
| `randomSeed` | integer | `1` |  | Seed for the random shape; vary it to decorrelate identical LFOs. |

### noise

**Noise.** Smoothed random signal that picks a new target value at a fixed rate.

Outputs: `value`, `bipolar`.

| Option | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frequency` | number, animatable | `3` | 0.1 – 30 | New random targets per second. |
| `smoothing` | number | `0.85` | 0 – 1 | How slowly the value glides towards each target (0 = jumps). |
| `seed` | integer | `1` |  | Random seed; vary it to decorrelate identical nodes. |
